spiritgiven.comments: Called 3rd timeout with out a timeout, and then called another timeout and then did follow the rules and increased count by 2, some increased body contact in second half, and felt like they did not listen to feedback.
A lot of knocking over our players after the catch

Sometimes called fast count after the throw and stall count but then retracted the call. One incident where our d called a trip foul and the other person said it should be a pick and we didn’t feel like it was a pick
Some accidental body contact because of quick play style and players crossing paths
Reminder to consider other people’s perspective to inform your stance on foul calls.

spiritreceived.comments: We felt Fair-mindedness in the first half was being affected by the translator as we saw in some calls they were not communicating with their player to translate but instead helping in the call itself. After feedback this got corrected and did not happen again in the second half
Fast Counts were not adjusted even after multiple reminders. Disc check ins were prolonged many times to talk tactics on the field. Please adjust. Good communication & attitude, thank you

There were multiple instances of fouls and body contact that was not appreciated by our team, and can be worked on for future games.

There was early and constant communication between our spirit captains, which was greatly appreciated :)
Great game with players listening to our perspective with good resolution of calls, thank you!

Both teams played this game with good attitude, and when there were calls, they talked to each other. We had a lot of pick calls in the first half, but we were able to fix them in the second half, so that was good. And someone on your team was able to tell their opinion correctly and showed great fair-mindedness. Thank you, team Chinese Taipei!

There was a little too much contact on the mark for our liking. Spatial awareness can also be improved on for future games (to look out for both our players and their own teammates) to avoid reckless plays.

Kudos to CT for working on the other feedback from the previous games :)
This game was our second time playing against Chinese Taipei in this tournament, and same as the first time, it was a great game with good communication between the teams. Thank you!!
